title: Callbacks, events, and the observer pattern — concept map
intro: Callback hell, EventEmitter, DOM events, delegation, pub/sub, and building small observer APIs from scratch.

conceptCards.title: Callback patterns and error-first conventions
conceptCards.summary: Node (err, result) convention, promisify bridge, and why throw in async callback is not a rejected Promise.

conceptCards.title: EventEmitter and custom pub/sub APIs
conceptCards.summary: Sync emit invokes listeners in order; unhandled error event throws — implement minimal emitter with off cleanup.
conceptCards.example: on returns unsubscribe; copy listeners before loop

conceptCards.title: DOM events, bubbling, capturing, and delegation
conceptCards.summary: Three-phase dispatch; one parent listener + closest() for dynamic lists; preventDefault ≠ stopPropagation.

conceptCards.title: Callback hell and composing async before Promises
conceptCards.summary: Pyramid nesting → promisify + async/await; parallel independent steps with Promise.all not deeper nest.

conceptCards.title: Implementing debounce and throttle from scratch
conceptCards.summary: Debounce waits for quiet; throttle caps rate — setTimeout closures, cancel on unmount, Rx Throttle in C#.

conceptCards.title: JavaScript events versus C# delegates and events
conceptCards.summary: C# event restricts who invokes; JS emit is public — typed wrappers approximate EventHandler<T>.
